title: Python: N3 x = Cls(); x() dispatches to type(x).__call__ (DEC-303 (a22) item 3, (a23) step 4)
description: Admitted group N3: calling a local bound once to a constructed instance, x = Cls(); x(), dispatches to type(x).__call__ resolved on the MRO of Cls. Same binding enumeration as bare calls; __new__ and metaclass checks as E1; a missing __call__ stays unresolved. Fixtures red before, green after, negatives that reach the branch. Interacts with A1 (star bases) and E1. Q2 and Q3 stay out; python-gate fenced.
implementationNotes: N3 built, 2026-11-26T04:10Z: resolveInstanceCall in src/python/calls.ts, tried in resolveBareCall before resolveBareName: the name must have exactly one binding in the lookupBindings enumeration (every rebinding kind, global write included, leaves it unresolved), that binding an assignment whose rhs is a construction; the class comes from instanceClassOf (shared with E1: ok MRO, no __new__ in the MRO, no effective metaclass), then methodLookup(cls, '__call__') and only an inRepo result is used (no __call__, or an opaque base, falls through to the old outcome). Fixtures (test/python-calls.test.ts 'N3', 5 tests): positives (module, function-local, inherited, imported); 12 second-binding kinds of x; class-name rebinding, __new__, metaclass; no __call__ own/inherited/opaque; C() itself still constructs. Red before: the positive test fails without the src change; the negatives are green both ways and sit next to the positive that reaches the branch. PER-SITE RE-MEASURE, instrumented worktrees at origin/dev 8729662 vs the branch, five pins with markerDirsFor, multiset diff on bin/reason/edge flags: entry counts equal. flask, jinja, httpx: 0 changed. rich: 17 name(run-time-bound) to inRepo (13 in rich/ package or examples: highlighter() calls reaching Highlighter.__call__ at rich/highlighter.py:20 in align.py, traceback.py, table.py, examples/log.py and rainbow.py; tests/test_highlighter.py:19; tests/test_progress.py:58,89,92 reaching ProgressColumn.__call__ at rich/progress.py:514); nameNotBound 323 to 306, inRepo 5562 to 5579. tqdm: 5 name to inRepo (tests/tests_tqdm.py:815-819, ema(...) reaching EMA.__call__ at tqdm/std.py:228); nameNotBound 320 to 315, inRepo 797 to 802. Total 22 changed entries, all name to inRepo, 13 of 22 in rich package source or examples (rich/ 10: align 3, table 1, traceback 6; examples 3), polymorphic and multiplyBound counts unchanged on all five. I read the highlighter, EMA and ProgressColumn examples; they are the x = Cls(); x() shape. NOT MEASURED: precision of the 22 edges beyond reading examples (held-out spent, python-gate fenced); a __call__ assigned on the instance or class by an attribute write is the (a25) rule, not yet built; a replacing class decorator is unchecked, as for E1. The three E1 design items routed to opum-doc apply here too (polymorphic flag, opaque-base __new__, no extra checks).
